about_the_game:
Anatomy of the Terrible is a small-scale horror experience focused on exploration and puzzle solving in an ever intensifying environment. Enter the home, explore its secrets, do what you can to get out alive.

  • Reach Back to the Early Days of Survival Horror - A vile, low-poly experience awaits you within the chambers of the Ludlow abode. Experience a unique art style handcrafted to be disgusting in all of the best ways.

  • Sound Designed to Scare - Gritty visuals are only half of the horror. Great care and attention to detail has gone into crafting an audio experience that is as upsetting as possible. 

  • The Best of Both Perspectives - Explore the house through our eyes, solve puzzles through yours. A fixed camera system that hides secrets just out of frame and a first person system that makes puzzle solving intuitive and snappy. 

  • Short Form Horror - A compact experience designed to be finished within an hour.  

  • From the Bottom of Our Twisted Hearts - A student capstone, evolved and mutated into an abomination birthed just for you. We hope our creation oozes from your monitor, and that you can't sleep after playing it.

content_descriptors.notes: Anatomy of the Terrible depicts blood, corpses, creatures changed beyond recognition and intense mental anguish. There are also frequent allusions to mental health struggles.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel 12600k or Ryzen 5600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia 2070 or Radeon RX 6800
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: Experience a tale of horror driven by its intense and oppressive atmosphere. Take control of Andrew - an EMT convinced that the occupant of 623 Lumber Lane is dead. Explore the decrepit domicile, discover its secrets and unravel a depraved tale of creation.
